messages:
Sam R: Re-opening this thread to track postmortem follow-ups for the streaming partials/timeouts incident. Keeping it compact: owners, due dates, and canary plan.

Priya N: Short impact summary: ~2% mid-stream silence (>3s) across Hosted during last regression window; partials ~0.4%. Correlated with background eviction job.

Zoe K: Root cause from traces: KV eviction can preempt the flush loop, causing brief stalls clients treat as silence.

eng-sre-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-678. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/streaming-partials (tags: reconnect, timeout)

Sam R: Proposed immediate actions (low-risk first):
- SDK: make resume dedupe opt-in + backoff defaults (owner: Priya) due 2026-04-01
- Observability: synthetic probe + silence metric + alert (owner: Zoe) due 2026-03-29
- Runtime: add kv_eviction_atomic toggle + eviction metrics (owner: Sam) due 2026-03-26

Priya N: SDK defaults draft:
```json
{"resumeDedupeWindowMs":3000, "maxReconnects":3, "initialBackoffMs":150, "maxBackoffMs":6000}
```

Zoe K: Synthetic plan: 60s stream, assert no gap >2.5s. Metric: telemetry.streaming.silence_pct. Alert: page SRE if >0.5% sustained 10m. Dashboard split by model/region/deployment. Promoting to staging target 2026-03-28.

Sam R: Runtime: short lock around eviction vs flush to avoid interleaving and emit eviction.lock_ms. Will gate behind kv_eviction_atomic toggle for canary. PR goal 2026-03-24.

deploy-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC. Reminder set.

Priya N: Canary suggestion: 2k concurrent streams for 8m, force eviction every 20s. Target silence_pct < 0.3% and reconnect rate returns to baseline. Run in maintenance window.

Zoe K: I'll include a histogram of silence gaps so SDK can be tuned per-model. Synthetic in dev already, dev dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/stream/silence-dev

Sam R: Rollback plan: flip kv_eviction_atomic=false if regressions. SDK resume-dedupe will be opt-in for one release before flipping default.

Priya N: Owners + dates recap:
- Priya N — SDK doc & draft PR — 2026-04-01
- Zoe K — synthetic + alert + dashboard — 2026-03-29
- Sam R — kv_eviction_atomic PR + metrics — 2026-03-24
- Sam R — coordinate canary & closure note — 2026-04-03

Zoe K: Synthetic promoted to staging after one clean run. Will post link.

Sam R: PR created, will link when CI passes.

eng-sre-bot: INC-2026-678 updated: Zoe K added synthetic metric.

Sam R: Thanks — please post short status updates here as you make progress. Closing for now unless blockers appear.

Priya N: Will update when SDK PR is ready.

Zoe K: :thumbsup: Synthetic promoted to staging, dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/streaming/silence-staging

Sam R: Noted. Closing thread, will publish closure checklist after canary.
